Independent bounded n=5 enumeration of pairs and 120 simultaneous relabelings in this review: 3,106 pairs, 1,260 essential rank-two pairs, 17 essential rank-two orbits and 15 rank-three orbits, hence d_5=35. The result is reported in the scientific check; no standalone replay file was saved for it.
correctness.rationale: Since t² fixes the image of t, each functional component is a fixed-root star or a two-cycle with direct leaves. The two commutation/absorption relations make e constant on each such component with image among the fixed points of t, and e²=e distinguishes one fixed-root star in each fiber. Thus the fiber series is UPH, with floor(j/2) two-cycle types of size j from unordered splits of j−2 leaves. Taking a multiset of fibers and subtracting the no-cycle case gives exactly the rank-three orbits. In the Gould–Grau–Johnson generation regime n≥5, a nonessential rank-two pair is a square (u²,e) of a rank-three pair. A 2-cycle of u supplies two nondistinguished roots in one e-fiber; conversely swapping any two such roots and sending each of their leaves to the opposite root constructs a permissible u with u²=t. Essential fibers thus have at most one extra star and contribute U(1+U), with coefficient j in degree j. Subtracting the rank-one multiset produces MacMahon minus P. Proposition 4.2 then supplies the generator count, and logarithmic differentiation gives the stated coefficient recurrence. The n≥5 restriction is necessary for this use of Proposition 4.2.
residual_risks: The independent enumeration corroborates one size only. The original n=6 replay is recorded evidence, not a new run. The all-size argument uses the structural premise; no exceptional-dimension generator claim is accepted.
